events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Trailside Tune Up with Daily Cycle AVL. Hands-on clinic for all skill levels covering skipping shifting, chain issues, rubbing brakes, and valve core problems. Drink token and small snack provided. Rain or shine event. For women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune event with Cane Creek Components. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on downhill trails with rocks and roots. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. First 8 emails to register with Dorene O'Malley. No e-bikes allowed. For women 18 or older.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery (342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712). No e-bikes allowed. For women 18 or older. Sign up opens Sunday, November 1 at 7 pm.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing (25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231). No e-bikes allowed. For women 18 or older. Sign up opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 pm.
